mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_duty_lease WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_duty_lease SET status = #{newStatus}, close_reason = #{closeReason}, update_time = #{now} WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, c.lease_count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (agent_id) * FROM agent_duty_lease WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY agent_id, start_time DESC, id DESC ) t JOIN ( SELECT agent_id, COUNT(*) AS lease_count FROM agent_duty_lease WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY agent_id ) c ON c.agent_id = t.agent_id ORDER BY t.start_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT agent_id) FROM agent_duty_lease WHERE deleted = 0
